game_concept: A speed quiz set in The Kingdom – Orchard Lane, the royal orchard lane: the knight must handle thieves while practicing variables & assignment. Core idea – Memory Map: Place variable cards on a memory board so the royal seal reads the right value at run time.
theme: The Kingdom – Orchard Lane: the royal orchard lane
core_gameplay_loop: In Orchard Lane, repeat each round: Place variable cards on a memory board so the royal seal reads the right value at run time. Each round, a new scrolls challenge appears; solve it to bank points before time drains. Then check the y value and advance.
player_objective: Collect 100 points of scrolls by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 100, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 1 – Variables & Assignment | Level 2 (intro tier): Memory Map
assets_style: storybook pixel-art kingdom: green meadows, red-roofed towers, royal blue and gold trim; flat Kenney-style sprites; bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Memory Map' (Week 1 slot 9), mission type 'Resource Rush', and setting 'Orchard Lane'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: The Kingdom
region.mood: bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how y changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against thieves in Orchard Lane.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: score >= 100 within 46 seconds.
